title: Penalizing Transparency? How AI Disclosure and Author Demographics Shape Human and AI Judgments About Writing

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing human and LLM evaluations (rating trustworthiness, comprehensiveness, writing quality, and share likelihood) of a news article where the author's race (Asian, Black, White) is systematically varied using photos, names, and biographies.

Comparing human and LLM evaluations (rating trustworthiness, comprehensiveness, writing quality, and share likelihood) of a news article where the author's gender (man, woman, non-binary) is systematically varied using photos, names, pronouns, and biographies.
